text: The police's part shown and told in the sitting-room: the body, the pockets, the cork
why: The story so far never mentions a sitting-room, the pockets, or a cork. It only says the body lies upstairs; the police's examination of these details has not been told yet.
Paragraph 73 states that Straker's body 'lies upstairs' in the house where the party is.
Paragraph 73 says 'The inquest is to-morrow,' and paragraph 13 places the current day on Thursday, so tomorrow is Friday.
